purpose: Teach: 後世/頭部/低音/女子大/無能/野望/処女/侮辱

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、後世に残る商品を作れ
lines.en: I want us to create products that will endure for generations.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Each word carries weight. Deliberate pacing, no rush. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard and heeded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の頭部保護を工事現場で徹底します
lines.en: Understood. We'll ensure rigorous safety protocols for our staff on all construction sites.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation with steady conviction. Direct eye contact implied. Professional but not distant — showing he's absorbed the directive and committed to action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、BGMの低音域を見直せ
lines.en: The low-frequency range in our audio products needs reexamining.
lines.style: Another directive delivered with the same clarity. Slight pause before the core instruction. Clinical precision — this is a problem identified, now to be solved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。女子大向け新商品ラインを企画します
lines.en: Yes. We'll develop a new product line targeting female university students.
lines.style: Swift acknowledgment. No hesitation — mapping the directive to concrete action. Brisk, capable, showing he understands the business implication.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員を無能扱いする上司を厳しく指導しろ
lines.en: Any manager who treats staff as incompetent needs strict corrective counsel.
lines.style: Firmer now — moral weight underneath. Slight hardening of the consonants. The statement of someone who won't tolerate that kind of leadership culture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の野望を共有します
lines.en: Understood. We'll ensure everyone on the team carries forward the founder's vision.
lines.style: Earnest affirmation. Slightly broader scope than before — not just task execution but cultural alignment. Warm beneath the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、処女作の出版社的役割を担え
lines.en: Our company will take on a publishing role for inaugural works in this space.
lines.style: Expansive directive. The tone widens slightly — strategic, visionary. Deliberate enunciation of the ambition. Still authoritative, but with a touch of forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様を侮辱しない接客を徹底します
lines.en: Yes. We'll establish a service standard that treats every customer with respect.
lines.style: Final confirmation, resonant with the corrective directive from earlier. Steady, resolute. The closing statement of someone solidifying a new standard for the company.
